correctness.rationale: For each fixed even p≥4, H=v^p/p+V(u), V=u²−u³/3, is conserved exactly. The critical points u=0,2 and V(2)=4/3 yield precisely one regular compact oval for each h∈(0,4/3). The physical-time dt/du=p^(−α)(h−V)^(−α) produces T=2p^(−α)I0 and axial translation per lap T(I1/I0−1), so full-space periodicity occurs exactly when d_p=0. ∫dv=0 over an oval gives I2=2I1. Center rescaling u=√h s and the beta-function moment ratio yield T∼2p^(−α)B(1/2,1/p)h^(−β), d=−1+[p/2(p+2)]h+o(h). At the saddle 4/3−V=(u+1)(2−u)²/3 gives δ^β I0→B(1/p,β)/2 and the separately finite J=∫(2−u)(h−V)^(−α)→3^(2/p)B(1/p,2/p), proving T∼p^(−α)B(1/p,β)δ^(−β) and d=1−[2·3^(2/p)B(1/p,2/p)/B(1/p,β)]δ^β+o(δ^β). Endpoint singularities are integrable for 1/2<α<1; the strict asymptotic endpoint signs make zeros exist. Analytic Poincaré return and compact containment of zeros prove finiteness; h≤2/3 has b(h)≤1 and d<0. Both period endpoint limits are infinite so an interior global minimum exists. Independent exact symbolic differentiation and weighted quadratures for p=4,6,8 substantiate, but are not substituted for, the infinite theorem.

value.rationale: This is a natural higher-even-kinetic deformation of a named quadratic-kinetic polynomial skew-flow, in which both a degenerate center and a finite outer separatrix affect physical-time observables. Exact beta-function leading periods and first nontrivial drift corrections resolve both singular ends, and analyticity plus their opposite drift signs classify a nonempty finite collection of full three-dimensional periodic cylinders. Those exact invariants and existence/finite classification are useful at the level of the natural family and not a generic change of symbols from p=2. The result makes no claim to a full census of energies, uniqueness of the period minimum, global escape classification or dynamical robustness.
residual_risks: Only the even integer p≥4 family of this particular polynomial skew flow is classified.
Qualitative existence of a cylinder was previously known in the p=2 case; the contribution here is changed kinetic geometry, all-p family, precise two-end coefficients and finite-zero classification.
